Use_Case: Workshop/course level introduction — big picture engagement before reading
Structure: Hook question → Host intro → Deep discussion → Key takeaways → Recap
Script_Template: Upload content as source → Set instructions: '{context}. Discuss in Vietnamese like 2 friends exploring the topic. Focus on WHY not HOW.' → Generate deep-dive
Best_Practice: Always provide ALL source content to NotebookLM — quality = f(source quality). Use deep-dive format for overviews.
Anti_Pattern: Single host when need discussion|No source context = generic output|Too many topics in one podcast|Using brief format for complex topics
Example: NotebookLM podcast discussing 'Tại sao Context Engineering quan trọng hơn Model?' with real examples

Use_Case: Per-session audio guide — learner listens WHILE reading for dual-coding reinforcement
Structure: Greeting → Session topic → 3 key points → One memorable takeaway
Best_Practice: Write conversational — contractions + short sentences. Read aloud before generating. Max 150 words per script.
Anti_Pattern: Formal writing tone|Reading the entire page content|Scripts > 200 words = unnatural pace|Inconsistent voice across sessions
Example: 'Chào bạn! Session 1.1 — Context Engineering. Có một công thức quan trọng: Output Quality = Model × Context × Constraints...'

Use_Case: Product feature explanation or onboarding narration
Structure: Problem → Solution → How it works → Key benefit → CTA
Script_Template: {problem_statement}. {product_name} giải quyết bằng cách {solution}. Cách hoạt động: {steps}. Kết quả: {benefit}. {cta}.
Best_Practice: Lead with the PROBLEM not the feature. One feature per explainer. Under 2 min for best retention.
Anti_Pattern: Feature dumping without context|Too technical for target audience|No clear CTA|Trying to cover everything in one explainer
Example: 'Bạn đã bao giờ mất hàng giờ setup lại AI mỗi project mới? EaseUI Gems giải quyết bằng...'

Use_Case: Product launch announcements + promotional audio for social/ads
Structure: Hook (5s) → Value prop (10s) → Social proof (5s) → CTA (5s)
Best_Practice: Deliver core message in first 5 seconds. Mention brand within 5s. ONE message per promo — don't overload.
Anti_Pattern: Multiple messages in one promo|Burying the CTA|Generic claims without proof|Too long (> 30s loses attention)
Example: '3 triệu downloads. 4.9 sao. 15 quốc gia. EaseUI — component library cho React Native. Thử ngay tại easeui.dev.'

Use_Case: Step-by-step technical tutorial narration synced with screen recording
Structure: Intro (what we'll build) → Prerequisites → Step 1-N → Result → Next steps
Script_Template: {what_building}. Trước khi bắt đầu bạn cần {prereqs}. Bước 1: {step1}. {explanation}. Bước 2: {step2}...
Best_Practice: Number every step explicitly. Pause between steps (use '...' in script). State expected result after each step.
Anti_Pattern: Skipping prerequisites|Going too fast between steps|Not stating expected results|Assuming viewer knowledge
Example: 'Hôm nay chúng ta sẽ tạo một Gemini Gem đầu tiên. Bạn cần: tài khoản Google và 10 phút. Bước 1: mở gemini.google.com...'

Use_Case: Customer success story or project case study narrated as audio
Structure: Context → Challenge → Solution → Results → Lessons learned
Script_Template: Công ty {name} gặp vấn đề {challenge}. Họ đã thử {previous_attempts}. Bằng cách dùng {solution}, kết quả: {metrics}. Bài học: {lessons}.
Best_Practice: Always lead with RESULTS in the hook then explain how. Use specific numbers — '60% faster' beats 'much faster'.
Anti_Pattern: Vague results without numbers|Making it a product pitch instead of a story|No lessons learned section|Too polished — losing authenticity
Example: 'EaseUI đạt 172 signups trong 3 ngày đầu tiên, từ 11 quốc gia, không tốn 1 đồng quảng cáo. Đây là câu chuyện...'

Use_Case: End-of-level knowledge check or recap narration
Structure: Quick recap → Quiz question 1-3 → Pause for thinking → Reveal answer
Script_Template: Hãy ôn lại Level {N}. {recap_3_points}. Câu hỏi 1: {q1}. Hãy suy nghĩ... {pause}. Đáp án: {a1}.
Best_Practice: Add '...' pauses after questions to give thinking time. Celebrate correct mental answers with positive reinforcement.
Anti_Pattern: No pause for thinking|Too many questions (max 5)|Not reviewing answers|Skipping the recap going straight to quiz
Example: 'Ổn rồi! Ôn lại Level 1. Ba điểm chính:... Câu hỏi: Context Window giống cái gì?... Đúng rồi! Bộ nhớ tạm.'

Use_Case: Project or startup pitch audio — concise value proposition delivery
Best_Practice: Practice 10x before final recording. Time it — cut anything over 90s. Lead with the biggest pain point not your solution.
Anti_Pattern: Starting with 'We are...' instead of the problem|Including too many features|No traction data|Asking without establishing credibility
Example: 'Mỗi founder mất trung bình 6 tháng build lại infra. EaseStart rút xuống 6 phút với AI agent system. 172 waitlist trong 3 ngày...'

Use_Case: Welcome narration for new users or workshop participants
Structure: Welcome → What to expect → How to use → First action → Support
Script_Template: {welcome}. Trong {workshop/product} này bạn sẽ {outcomes}. Cách dùng: {instructions}. Hãy bắt đầu bằng {first_action}. Nếu cần hỗ trợ: {support}.
Best_Practice: Make the FIRST ACTION crystal clear and achievable in under 2 minutes. Reduce anxiety by setting expectations.
Anti_Pattern: Overwhelming with info on first contact|No clear first action|Too formal for a welcome|Assuming they know the interface
Example: 'Chào mừng bạn đến workshop AI Agent Mastery! Trong 3 levels, bạn sẽ đi từ user → customizer → builder...'

Use_Case: Audio summary of product updates or release notes
Structure: Top change → Other changes → What's improved → What's next
Script_Template: {top_feature}. Ngoài ra: {change_2}, {change_3}. Cải thiện: {improvement}. Sắp tới: {roadmap_hint}.
Best_Practice: Lead with the BIGGEST change. Keep under 2 min. End with a teaser for what's coming next to build anticipation.
Anti_Pattern: Listing every bug fix|No prioritization — treating all changes equally|Too long for minor updates|No 'what's next' teaser
Example: 'Version 2.3 — lớn nhất tháng này! Data table component hoàn toàn mới, dark mode cải thiện, build nhanh hơn 40%...'

Use_Case: Script and talking points for podcast interviews or Q&A sessions
Structure: Warm intro → Background → Core questions (3-5) → Lightning round → Recap + CTA
Script_Template: Giới thiệu: {guest_name} — {credential}. Câu hỏi 1: {q1}... Follow-up: {follow_up}. Lightning: {quick_q1}, {quick_q2}.
Best_Practice: Research guest deeply — ask questions they haven't answered before. Prepare follow-ups for each question. Lightning round creates energy.
Anti_Pattern: Generic questions easily Googled|Not researching the guest|Interrupting during good stories|No follow-up questions — just reading the list
Example: Research guest's 3 most recent talks → Prepare 5 questions they haven't been asked → 3 lightning round questions

Use_Case: Full educational module narration for e-learning or LMS
Structure: Hook → Objectives → Prior knowledge bridge → Content chunks (3-4) → Summary → Exercise prompt
Script_Template: Gagné flow: {attention_hook}. Mục tiêu: {objectives}. Nhắc lại: {prior_knowledge}. Nội dung: {chunk_1}... {chunk_2}... {chunk_3}. Tóm lại: {summary}. Bây giờ hãy: {exercise}.
Best_Practice: Follow Gagné's 9 Events. Chunk content into 3-4 segments with transitions. Max 15 min — split longer modules.
Anti_Pattern: Monotone delivery for long content|No chunking — one continuous wall of narration|Skipping exercises|No connection to prior modules
Example: Full Gagné-structured narration for 'Context Engineering' module: hook → objectives → 3 concept chunks → quiz prompt
